title: LanguageAdapterPortsCatalog
description: SSOT for the language-adapter port catalog (F-LANGUAGE-ADAPTER-PLUGIN-INFRASTRUCTURE slice-01 walking-skeleton floor). Machine-readable distillation of docs/architecture/language-adapter-catalog.md; consumed by scripts/cli/validate_language_adapter_catalog.py and src/des/cli/doctor.py.

schema-version.description: Catalog schema version. Pinned to the single legal value until an ADR authorises a major bump.

supported-languages.description: First-class target-language identifiers the catalog enumerates plugin coverage for. Slice-01 floor: python, typescript, go (Nova-audit first-class set).

ports.description: Per-port enumeration. Each entry pins a port-id, classification, and witness file:symbol references.

port-id.description: Stable kebab-or-PascalCase port identifier (e.g., TestRunnerPort, run_contract_gate).

witnesses.description: Repo-relative file paths grounding this port to the codebase. Validator grep-finds every entry; missing path => exit 1 (CitedPathNotFound).

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary for operator-facing CLI output.
